# AI Ecommerce Workflow

AI Ecommerce Workflow is an evidence-first Agent Skill for public ecommerce market research, editable platform-specific listing drafts (marketplace listing copy), and marketplace image requirements.

## Start

- Repository: https://github.com/mianbaofang/ai-ecommerce-workflow
- Published v1.1.1 Skill entrypoint: https://github.com/mianbaofang/ai-ecommerce-workflow/blob/v1.1.1/skills/ai-ecommerce-workflow/SKILL.md
- English overview: https://mianbaofang.github.io/ai-ecommerce-workflow/
- Chinese overview: https://mianbaofang.github.io/ai-ecommerce-workflow/index-zh.html
- English workflow demo: https://mianbaofang.github.io/ai-ecommerce-workflow/readme-animation-en.html
- Chinese workflow demo: https://mianbaofang.github.io/ai-ecommerce-workflow/hyperframes-promo/

## Release status

- Latest public release: v1.1.1, using the `skills/ai-ecommerce-workflow/` install layout.

Provide a product description, public product URL, or product image. The first output is a one-page public-market brief. Select a marketplace before requesting platform-specific copy, image requirements, or an optional image brief.

## Supported Scope

- Public comparable-product discovery, observed display-price context, and source-state evidence ledgers.
- Platform adapters for Taobao/Tmall, JD, Pinduoduo, Douyin, Kuaishou, Amazon, eBay, Etsy, Shopify, and AliExpress.
- A ten-platform image-requirement matrix and fact, category, claim, and marketplace-field review.

## Delivery

- A source-state evidence ledger, comparable-product context, and editable marketplace copy drafts.
- Platform image requirements and optional image briefs for the selected marketplace.
- Fact, category, claim, and marketplace-field review items alongside each draft.
- Provider-neutral operation: no bundled API keys, login-only access, bulk crawling, or auto-publishing.
